folds.heading: ## Complete lead-brief reconciliation, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
Read the historical document candidate, every LR/UT/TR/HM/HB uptake, I/PC recommendations, source/compatibility packet and later FN/B96 additions. Current full-journey routing supersedes the early destruction candidate’s opening order and old allowance/lease stops. Preserve the candidate’s unresolved actual carrier/scene identity without relocating it to make a convenient opening or claiming that a later method-use receipt proves this destruction loop. B153 records the later M21/M22/M25 release at its actual native command/paper/recipient scope; it is not a universal document, source-arrival or late-power completion claim (AD32, AD36, AD43).

Keep the source pressures usable at their real consumer: perception, initial acquisition, established command and movement have different reach; body appearance does not establish agency; a holder need not be a payer or benefit recipient; a support link differs from containment. Current observation, attributed memory, interpreted claim, delivered information and hazardous acquisition have different lifecycles. An inspector redraw is no new exposure, and destroying one carrier neither erases remembered content nor forbids every later recovery mechanism. Disclosure follows actual recipients rather than narrator knowledge. Unknown numbers, sequel/edition boundaries, proposed experiments and practical-scene gaps remain unknown.

Separate ritual agreement, preparation, response, consumption, transfer, acknowledgment, use, payment and closure where their actual terms differ. A symbol or claimed rank does not replace physical custody or enforcement. A lasting completed change may outlive temporary support; exact per-output aftermath remains local. AD51 permits reasonable shared design before another implemented world, with its differences validating/revising the seam. No complete projection engine, global range law, all-history simulator or thirty-book research wave is a prerequisite for the next real consumer. The existing full-life target still needs source/route/functional/continuity coverage rather than one blended percentage, and compressed routine work follows current ACR principles without losing significant choices or long play. No runtime, private source, new budget or implementation assignment was changed here.
